r145/ordinary-terminal-signed-clipping.question: Can clipping a true optimum at a growing but sub-square-root terminal scale preserve the terminal signed criterion?
r145/ordinary-terminal-signed-clipping.scope: Use ordinary primes p=1 mod 4, fixed positive tau, exact true sign-s optimizer, original mark and growing selectable T with T+1 inside the simultaneous window. On the bulk clip F at L=o(sqrt T), keep F0, and restore mean on the bulk. Then take tau down last.
r145/ordinary-terminal-signed-clipping.remaining: Construct a genuinely prime-uniform sequence of approximate rows with both low terminal activation and small positive signed residual. Try real clipped and approximate sector constructions separately.

r145/ordinary-terminal-approx-sector.question: Can prime-specific Fourier smoothing construct nonnegative near-root rows with small full forbidden-sector norm and small actual activation?
r145/ordinary-terminal-approx-sector.scope: Work at fixed tau in the same real growing marked window. Keep mean one, positivity, q=q_s+o(sqrt n), weighted terminal cost o(T) and forbidden RMS o(T^(-1/2)) on each sign. Use a strategy distinct from clipping an exact optimizer and control the near-root loss. Take the floor down last.
r145/ordinary-terminal-approx-sector.remaining: Construct a genuinely prime-uniform sequence of approximate rows with both low terminal activation and small positive signed residual. Try real clipped and approximate sector constructions separately.

r145/cold-full-selected-unshifted-price.question: Does the complete Jacobi-series mixed action linear in the actual Legendre center have a small P5000 price on the unshifted canonical C1 source?
r145/cold-full-selected-unshifted-price.scope: Use both orders, actual unshifted C1 input, original closed cold square and actual t0=n. Include the nine residual families through beta^2, all later orders, finite mark and lift corrections. Judge the bound against the canonical source budget pi(1)=1; do not substitute an operator norm.
r145/cold-full-selected-unshifted-price.remaining: Join total signed coefficients, residual charges and analytic tail to price the full selected unshifted C1 action. A general packet operator, actual nonlinear half step, and common marked domain remain open.

comparison: The precise real clipping question asks for a signed bound on a deleted tail of a true optimizer at a fixed reconstruction. The second real question instead seeks an unclipped approximate nonnegative near-root construction at a full forbidden-sector RMS scale; neither obligation is identified with the other's signal bound. The cold selected two-step price has independent hypotheses and objectives.
